observations: White chest freezer with a top-opening lid.
The interior walls are made of silver-colored metal.
The interior base has a grid pattern for storage.
The exterior shows significant rust and peeling paint at the bottom edge.
A sticker on the front identifies the brand as 'Haier Thermocool'.
The rear of the unit shows the cooling coils and a power cord.
The unit appears to be a standard 100L capacity model.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows the lid handle design typical of string-type freezers

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The unit may not cool or may have a faulty compressor.
risks.proof: A video showing the unit plugged in and the interior frost forming.

risks.risk: The compressor may be seized or leaking refrigerant.
risks.proof: A video of the unit running with a thermometer inside.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full compressor replacement

risks.risk: The interior may be rusted or have hidden leaks.
risks.proof: A photo of the interior with a water bottle placed inside to check for condensation.

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running.
Photo of the manufacturer's specification label (usually on the back) to confirm the model and capacity.
Photo of the interior with a thermometer to verify cooling performance.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
